name: StarPort combat numeric contract
description: Checks the configured default defence, durability damage formula, shield/fighter/hull retaliation order, and one-turn debit on the actual PostgreSQL server.

tests.name: Seed a standard port in an unprotected sector and controlled attacker layers

data.sql: WITH target AS (SELECT MIN(s.sector_id) AS sector_id FROM sectors s WHERE s.sector_id>10 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ports other WHERE other.is_active AND other.sector_id=s.sector_id AND other.port_id<>9)), moved_port AS (UPDATE ports SET sector_id=(SELECT sector_id FROM target),is_active=TRUE,durability=10000,defensive_strength=1000 WHERE port_id=9 RETURNING sector_id), moved_player AS (UPDATE players SET sector_id=(SELECT sector_id FROM moved_port) WHERE name='planet_gov' RETURNING player_id), moved_ship AS (UPDATE ships SET sector_id=(SELECT sector_id FROM moved_port),shields=999,fighters=5,hull=100 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='planet_gov') RETURNING ship_id) SELECT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM moved_port)=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM moved_player)=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM moved_ship)=1)::int;

tests.name: Authenticated arrival refreshes the ordinary player at the StarPort
First attack charges one turn and damage is max(1,maxattack-1000); retaliation exhausts shields then fighters
Verify first strike durability and persisted damage layers

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.durability=10000-GREATEST(1,st.maxattack-p.defensive_strength) AND p.defensive_strength=1000 AND r.result->>'retaliation'='1000' AND r.result->>'shields_lost'='999' AND r.result->>'fighters_lost'='1' AND r.result->>'hull_lost'='0' AND s.shields=0 AND s.fighters=4 AND s.hull=100 AND t.turns_remaining=@{starport_turns_before}-1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM ports p JOIN players pl ON pl.name='planet_gov' JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=pl.ship_id JOIN shiptypes st ON st.shiptypes_id=s.type_id JOIN turns t USING(player_id) JOIN v3_port_action_receipts r ON r.player_id=pl.player_id AND r.request_id='numeric-first-layer-001' WHERE p.port_id=9;

tests.name: Prepare second strike to carry retaliation through fighters into hull

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET shields=0,fighters=999,hull=100 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='planet_gov');

tests.name: Second attack consumes one turn and applies remaining retaliation to hull after fighters
Verify second strike and total turn accounting in PostgreSQL

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.durability=10000-2*GREATEST(1,st.maxattack-p.defensive_strength) AND s.shields=0 AND s.fighters=0 AND s.hull=99 AND t.turns_remaining=@{starport_turns_before}-2 AND (SELECT COUNT(*)=2 FROM v3_port_action_receipts r WHERE r.player_id=pl.player_id AND r.action='attack') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM ports p JOIN players pl ON pl.name='planet_gov' JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=pl.ship_id JOIN shiptypes st ON st.shiptypes_id=s.type_id JOIN turns t USING(player_id) WHERE p.port_id=9;
